::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Decr 26th 1877  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54921: 44-45
:::

Dear [Mr Craik](people/person_379.qmd)

About the name of [the Spanish book](cmy_books/cmybook_126.qmd) which certainly is rather suggestive of the uncomplimentary riddle ‘What is the difference between Truth and Fiction?  History and Her story  My book is really both - a bit of real history, and then a collection of the wonderful stories and ballads about it.

I do not know any book that does combine them both, and I want to mark that this does.

I shall send the first half dozen chapters which are done.

I am writing to [Mr Murray](people/person_2312.qmd)[^1]

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Black-edged paper.
[^2]: She wanted Murray's permission to use some of Lockhart's *Ancient Spanish Ballads* in her *The Story of the Christians and the Moors in Spain*.
